Because CountingEngine returns identical hardcoded values for all generations, the test would pass identically even if the cache were gen-keyed (broken). The deterministic property is correctly established by source-code inspection (chromosome_key as cache key), but the test name is misleading. Consider renaming to test_val_cadence_interval_3_5_gen_epoch or adding a true metric-equality assertion.
findings.recommendation: Rename the test or add an assertion that captures val metrics for the same chromosome key across multiple generations and confirms equality.
